svg.title: CAR-Treg targeting of an HLA-bearing graft cell
svg.desc: HLA-directed CAR-Tregs are investigational, not routine transplant tolerance therapy. CAR-Treg engineering and defined donor-Treg graft composition are separate strategies; no efficacy promise is drawn. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
